_comment: Phase 167.1.1.1 plan 02 (D-15, D-16, D-18) created this oracle; Phase 167.1.1.2 D-06 removed its only divergence, so each case now carries ONE expected value that BOTH runtimes must return. Shared oracle for the AUM basis. Both runners read this whole file: vitest (src/lib/holding-equity-contribution.parity.test.ts) replays it against holdingEquityContribution (src/lib/holding-equity.ts), its re-export from src/lib/queries.ts, AND the client alias holdingEquityContributionLocal; pytest (analytics-service/tests/test_holding_equity_contribution.py) replays it against holding_equity_contribution. Every figure is hand-typed; nothing is derived from the code under test. A derivative whose unrealized_pnl_usd is null is withheld (expected null: TypeScript null, Python None), never counted 0 and never replaced by notional. JSON cannot carry NaN or Infinity, so a field holding one is written {"nonfinite": "NaN" | "Infinity" | "-Infinity"} and decoded identically by both runners.
